features.title: Remote MCP server with authenticated tools

acceptance.check: An MCP client (Claude Code) connects to /mcp and lists the tools where_did_we_stop, get_context_pack, find_similar_component, list_features, save_progress, add_decision, create_checklist, propose_checklist_change, generate_receipt, check_package, plan_project

features.title: Change receipt: done, partly, missed, files by feature, out-of-scope edits

acceptance.check: Every receipt shows two separate states for items it cannot call done: 'Done, no test proves it' (the change has file evidence but no test changed) and 'Not verified' (Codeceipt could not check the item, e.g. no file evidence); neither is ever stored or shown as done

features.title: Stop gate: the agent cannot say done while the receipt disagrees

acceptance.check: When the Claude Code Stop hook's receipt has a missed item, a deleted/skipped/weakened test, a new secret or a table with RLS off, the hook blocks the stop with one short instruction listing those findings (Cursor: the stop hook returns them as followup_message)
The gate blocks at most 2 times per session; the 3rd stop is let through and the receipt says the gate gave up
A receipt with nothing blocking, a repo that is not linked, a server error or a timeout never blocks the stop
`codeceipt config stop-gate off` turns the gate off for this user (receipts still made); `on` turns it back on; default on

The instruction contains only Codeceipt's own wording, item texts the user typed, file paths and masked secrets; checklist text that looks like instructions is quoted as data and capped at 200 characters per item
The project owner creates a read-only link for one receipt; anyone with the link sees the receipt (request, items, checks, evidence summary) with a 'Receipt by Codeceipt' badge, without signing in
The owner revokes the link; the page then returns 404 and the link cannot be re-enabled (a new link gets a new token)
Only the project owner can create or revoke a link for its receipts (others get 404); the shared page shows nothing else from the project
Link tokens are at least 128 random bits and compared in constant time; guessed or altered tokens return 404; the page sends noindex and no-referrer and shows secrets masked
A project can have at most 100 active links; creating the 101st returns a clear error

features.title: Build and test evidence on receipts

acceptance.check: With a check command set for the repo (`codeceipt config check "npm test"`), the session end runs it locally and the receipt shows passed or failed, exit code and duration
The command is stopped after 5 minutes (configurable 30 s to 15 min) and the receipt says it timed out
The command is stored in the user's config on this computer, never read from the repo; a repo cannot set or change it
No command output is uploaded or stored: only passed/failed, exit code, duration and test counts when the output states them
Without a check command, receipts say 'not run' and nothing is executed

features.title: Receipts on push for GitHub-connected projects (Lovable, Bolt, Replit)

acceptance.check: A verified GitHub push webhook to a project's connected repository creates one receipt for that push: the commit messages are the request, changed files come from the GitHub compare API, and the secret, RLS, test-integrity and dependency checks run
The same push delivered twice creates one receipt (idempotent by repository and after-SHA)
An unsigned or wrongly signed webhook does nothing and returns 401; file contents fetched for checks are never stored (only findings, masked)
A push to a repository not connected to any project, or to a branch other than the default branch, creates no receipt
A push with more than 300 changed files gets a receipt that lists the first 300 and says the rest were not checked

`codeceipt rls` reads the live database given in SUPABASE_DB_URL on the user's computer and uploads per table: RLS on/off and allow-all policies; the dashboard and next receipts show tables open to anyone
The database URL and password are never uploaded, stored or printed; only table names and flags leave the computer
The check runs only read-only catalog queries (pg_class, pg_policies) in a read-only transaction
Without SUPABASE_DB_URL, or when the database cannot be reached in 10 s, the command explains how to set it and uploads nothing

features.title: Plans and billing: Free, Builder, Pro, Agency, founding offer

acceptance.check: A signed-in user picks Builder, Pro or Agency on /pricing, pays through Stripe Checkout, and the plan is active after Stripe's verified webhook

Plan limits apply: Free 1 project and 20 AI-judged receipts a month; Builder 5 projects and 150; Pro unlimited projects and 600; Agency 25 projects and 2,000. Over the limit, receipts are still made from git, without the AI judge, and say so
The plan only changes from a Stripe webhook with a valid signature; a client cannot set its own plan or price
The founding offer ($8 a month for Builder, 12 months) is shown and sold only while fewer than 200 founding subscriptions exist
Cancelling in the Stripe customer portal returns the account to Free at the end of the paid period; data is kept

features.notes: Needs a Stripe account and keys (human). New dependency: stripe (dep-check).

acceptance.check: The admin overview shows, per week of sign-up: signed up, linked a repo, first receipt, a receipt that caught something, and the share who reached first receipt within 10 minutes
Only admins can see the funnel; others get 404
The funnel for the last 12 weeks loads in under 1 s with 10,000 users (one aggregate query, no per-user loop)

requirements.text: The agent cannot end a session as done while its receipt shows missed items, weakened tests, secrets or open tables (with a cap)
Owners can share a read-only receipt with anyone through a revocable link
Receipts show whether the project's own build or tests still pass
Projects built in Lovable, Bolt or Replit get receipts from GitHub pushes, with no install
The live Supabase database is checked for tables open to anyone
Paid plans with limits and a founding offer
The owner can see how many sign-ups reach a first receipt
